This release gets the browser extension into all three stores and sends later releases there on their own. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Releases go to the stores on their own.** Once a release is out, the browser extension goes to the Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons and Firefox Add-ons, and the Android app to Google Play. Each goes only when it changed since the previous release, so no store reviews a copy of the last version.
- **An app bundle for Google Play**, `knightloader-v1.4.1-android.aab`, next to the APK and signed with the same key.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Buy Me a Coffee in the app opens a window** with the appeal and the donation page, as the web interface does. PayPal still opens in the browser.
- **The tray icon is called the icon in the notification area**, in the module, its two switches and the hints that mention it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Edge Add-ons accepts the browser extension.** The release carries two extension zips: `knightloader-extension.zip` for Chrome, Edge and the other Chromium browsers, and `knightloader-extension-firefox.zip` for Firefox.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new and renamed texts in all 42 languages, in the web interface and the app.
